text:
maria: quick idea — can we try "slotting" embedding requests by dim to avoid mixed-dim mixing costs? e.g. route 1536/1024/768 to dedicated slot pools so batching doesn't waste memory/kv swapping
ashok: interesting. means router needs dim header or preflight. we already have `X-Embed-Dims` in some clients, but it's optional
kevin: downside: more fragmentation of capacity. need slot autoscale heuristics (min reserve per dim) or you'll starve tails
jules: can we keep current policy but add a slow-path that coalesces mixed-dim in smaller minibatches? slotting only for high-traffic dims
maria: exactly — default unchanged. slotting = opt-in routing policy. console toggle per-model with suggested reserve % based on recent traffic\ashok: telemetry we need: per-dim p50/p95 latency, batch size distro, cross-dim spill rate, and slots utilization. also surface wasted tokens from padding/quantization penalties
kevin: +1 on wasted token metric. propose `embed.dim_waste_tokens` and `embed.slot_util` in statsd. add a console card that shows slot heatmap by hour
jules: UX: in console show recommended slot config (e.g. 2x 1536, 1x 1024) with expected cost delta. let users click "simulate" to run preflight on last 7 days workload
maria: preflight proto (rough):
```
POST /v1/embeddings:preflight
headers: {"Authorization": "Bearer ...", "X-Embed-Dims": "1536,1024"}
body: {"sample_window": "7d", "target_latency_p95_ms": 120}
```
returns: candidate slotting config + cost/latency sim
deploy-bot: deploy queued for feature/slot-router at sha a1b2c3 (staging) :rocket:
ashok: implement router fallback rules: if slot capacity full -> try same-dim best-effort smaller-batch -> fall back to mixed-dim slow-path -> reject with 413 if payload too big
kevin: quota implications: per-slot soft-quota + global quota. console should translate into simple UX: "Reserved capacity for 1536 dims: 8 slots (~$X/mo)"
jules: also add experiment flag `slot_router_enabled` per-customer. we can roll to 10% then 50% on dedicated customers
maria: outstanding questions: default slot sizes? time window for autoscale? what constitutes "high-traffic" dim? propose threshold: >500 reqs/min sustained for 5m
ashok: sounds reasonable. i'll draft a short PR with router proto + telemetry keys. anyone want to pair on console mockups?
kevin: I can mock a heatmap and cost sim widget tomorrow
jules: I'll write the experiment gating plan and rollback runbook (what to do if slot fragmentation increases latency)
maria: thanks — filing a tiny RFC and linking here. TL;DR: opt-in dim slotting, telemetry-first, console sim, gated rollout. :thumbsup:
